description: Remove a contact from a customer organization. The contact is kept; its `organization.*` attributes are cleared or replaced by another organization it belongs to.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Contact email. Creates the contact when adding a new one.

externalId.description: Customer-owned account (organization/workspace) ID, e.g. the org id in your app.

subscriberExternalId.description: Contact external ID, as an alternative to email.

name: remove_account_member

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_account_member` MCP tool.

account.description: The account record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

removed.description: True when a membership was removed.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
